STEP 7. Check the sunroof motor assembly power supply 
circuit [ignition switch (IG2)] at the sunroof motor 
assembly connector D-06 by back probing.
(1) Do not disconnect the sunroof motor assembly connector 
D-06.
(2) Turn the ignition switch to "ON" position.
(3) Measure the voltage between terminal 2 and ground by 
back probing.
Q: Is the voltage approximately 12 volts (battery positive 
voltage)?
YES : Go to Step 10.
NO : Go to Step 8.
STEP 8. Check the sunroof motor assembly connector D-
06 for damage.
Q: Is sunroof motor assembly connector D-06 in good 
condition?
YES : Go to Step 9.
NO : Repair or replace it. Refer to GROUP 00E, Harness 
Connector Inspection P.00E-2. The sunroof should 
work normally.
